plain_english_policy: This bill directs a specific salary increase for certain employees within Alabama's Department of Corrections who work inside security fences (such as correctional facilities and work release centers). The policy mandates an immediate one-time raise followed by annual increases until the total adjustment reaches 10%, separate from standard merit raises or cost-of-living adjustments. This action aims to improve compensation specifically for frontline staff in secure environments without altering existing pay structures for other employees.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce a targeted financial relief policy that increases the base salary of eligible corrections officers and staff by 2.5% annually, capping at a total increase of 10%, effective October 1, 2011 (or immediately upon passage if approved earlier). This creates a distinct pay tier or adjustment mechanism for these specific workers.
sponsorship_supports_position: Senator Means advanced this bill to increase compensation for corrections employees working inside security fences.
evidence_quotes: "This bill would provide for salary increases for certain employees of the Department of Corrections."
"all Merit System employees... who... work inside a correctional facility under the care, custody, and control of the department... shall receive a one-step, 2.5 percent, salary increase."
